summary: Fix two layout bugs reported by the owner: long concept names overflowing the learning-map side panel and cut off inside graph nodes (global nowrap on h3 and button), and the Today card's two button groups being left misaligned when they wrap. Front-end only.
scope_note: Committed on main from a worktree that holds only these files; another session's uncommitted work in the shared checkout (app/db.py, app/service.py, app/pathgraph.py, app/profile_insights.py and tests) is not part of it.

budget_impact.rationale: Stylesheet, markup and a layout constant only; no model call, data or network.
budget_impact.before: nowrap on every h3 and button made long names overflow; card action groups wrapped ragged.
budget_impact.after: Names wrap inside their container; wrapped action groups fill the row.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

open_risks: Not checked in the Tauri window, at other window heights, in dark mode or with display scaling; only widths 760-2560 were sampled.
The overflow scan sees horizontal overflow and clipped text, not overlap or vertical misalignment.
